description: Preview your Markdown manuscript as an ebook, leave structured notes, and guide the next AI revision.
command.export.title: Export EPUB
command.preview.title: Open EPUB Preview
configuration.title: Markdown Ebook Review — Human–AI Writing
configuration.splitLevel.description: Heading level used to split chapters. Use 2 to split at ##, or 1 to split only at #.
configuration.device.description: Device viewport used when the preview opens, in CSS pixels.
configuration.customWidth.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels when device is set to custom.
configuration.customHeight.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels when device is set to custom.
configuration.css.description: Path to a custom CSS file, relative to the Markdown file. Replaces the built-in stylesheet.
configuration.lang.description: Book language. Frontmatter lang takes precedence. Leave empty to follow the VS Code display language.
configuration.author.description: Book author. Frontmatter author takes precedence.
configuration.cover.description: Path to the cover image, relative to the Markdown file. Frontmatter cover takes precedence.
configuration.debounce.description: Milliseconds to wait after an edit before rebuilding the preview.
